news.title: Google finds self-running AI hacking tool with Russian comments in its files
news.summary: Google spots an AI that can find and exploit software flaws on its own, no human needed.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin stuck near $65,000 as popular 'basis trade' returns dry up
news.summary: XRP edged toward $1 and SOL rose 3%, while a Talos report showed crypto’s favorite carry trade now pays about what Treasuries do.

news.title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
news.summary: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the practice known as MEV.

news.title: Bitcoin's 12% slide through key support looks scary, but history says give it 3 months.
news.summary: Bitcoin broke below its 200-week average with a 12% drop. Only three similar crashes have occurred since 2013. Here’s what happened next.

news.title: XRP whales moved $270 million during the selloff. The coins didn’t go to exchanges
news.summary: A holder whose wallets trace back to a 2020 Bitstamp withdrawal has moved 281 million XRP into two vaults three weeks apart, a behavior indicative of custody rather than a large investor heading for the exit.

news.title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
news.summary: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.

news.title: Nvidia shares rise on earnings beat, raised outlook despite leadership uncertainty
news.summary: Speaking on the earnings call, Chairman Harvey Jones said the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO.

news.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
news.summary: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

news.title: CoreWeave’s stock pops — even as Nvidia talks up a ‘disciplined’ approach to financing
news.summary: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress said neoclouds are “increasingly important,” but added the company will take “a very strong look” at the customers it helps with financing.

news.title: Medicare Part B premiums rise due higher healthcare spending
news.summary: The premiums will increase by $6.50, to $209.40 a month.

news.title: Nvidia’s stock rises as blowout numbers help ease CEO transition fears
news.summary: Nvidia’s revenue growth and $130 billion quarterly forecast showed that demand for chips is still sky-high.

news.title: My husband is happily retired at 64 and thinks I should keep working. Is he being fair?
news.summary: “I’m exhausted. My alarm goes off at 6 a.m., and I have a 50-minute commute.”

news.title: I’m in my 40s. Should I accept a lower pension in exchange for naming my husband or child as a beneficiary?
news.summary: “If I die before my husband, he will receive a lifetime pension equal to 50%–66% of my monthly benefit.”

news.title: Costco is benefiting from ‘apocalyptic concerns’ as customers stock up on goods, analysts say
news.summary: Mizuho analysts have seen an “acceleration on emergency prep sales” at the warehouse chain following the Microsoft outage and nationwide flight stoppage.

news.title: ‘It’s downright dirty’: My brother took over our ailing mother’s life and finances. What can I do?
news.summary: “It is devastating when the people you should be able to trust become the very people you have to protect yourself from.”
